params.name: Krell Barrow 2076
params.note: The Barrow after the Mule (docs/proposals/hover-rigs.md): the Courier 2076 cut down to a cab-over and worn. Written by scripts/shapes/concepts/barrow-2076.mjs from mesh_truck_scrapper.json; edit that, not this. Same channels as the stock file: trailer (+t), parked (~p), fit_<code> (^code).
